description: Kernel-mystery probe (T-1778 round 3, erfc-probes): is there a branch (a second rational, a term-count change) at candidate breakpoints b? Each run is the 128 doubles below b, b itself (the 129th row of the run) and the 127 doubles above. A jump in the mean of ERFC/(exp(-fl(x*x))*erfcx_true) across b larger than about 0.5 ulp (128-point means have SE 0.17 ulp) marks a branch; the step at b itself tells x<b from x<=b. A = x, B = ERFC.PRECISE(x), C = EXP(-(x*x)).
